Select the wrong statement about alum
options: Its aqueous solution gives test of three types of ions
Its aqueous solution is acidic in nature
Its constituents ions retain their identity in aqueous solution
Its constituents ions loose their identity in aqueous solution
questions.explanation:
In aqueous solution, alum dissociates into its constituent ions (e.g., K⁺, Al³⁺, SO₄²⁻) which retain their identity, not lose it.

Thus, option D is wrong.
